ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The report is generated at exactly 23:59:59 on the current day.
evidence_from_context: Business rule BR-01: 'For reporting purposes, end of day is defined as 23:59:59 UTC on the calendar day.'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The business rule explicitly defines 'end of day' as 23:59:59 UTC, eliminating the ambiguity between the end of the current day and the start of the next day.
